name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: A styled native textarea for multi-line text — auto-sizing to its content, invalid and disabled chrome, and the background focus tint with a border that never moves (FOC-14).

meta.whenToUse: Multi-line free text — descriptions, comments, messages, notes.
meta.whenNotToUse: Single-line entry (input), rich text (editor), or fixed options (select).
